# howitworks

> An interactive engineering-drawing skill for Claude Code that explains mechanisms and software concepts through physical cutaways and live simulations.

howitworks is an Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for Claude Code. Given one line, e.g. "/howitworks explain how a pin tumbler lock opens", Claude picks the real object whose mechanism *is* the idea, then drafts a live A2 engineering sheet: a section through the mechanism, details at larger scale, true dimensions, numbered balloons with part cards, a parts list and a title block, all driven by one physical model (pressure, flow, force, cycles). It can also build a 3D cutaway you can turn, cut open and explode. Rule: "The cut is the explanation."

## Who it is for
- Engineering students and educators: explore mechanisms, forces, pressure, motion and thermodynamic cycles interactively.
- Developers: understand software concepts (rate limiting, back-pressure, authentication, state machines, load balancing, debounce, circuit breakers) as physical machines.
- Technical product teams: explain how physical products and mechanisms work in documentation and training.

## Install
- npm: `npx howitworks` (copies the skill into ~/.claude/skills/howitworks; `--project` for this project only)
- skills CLI: `npx skills add hariFED/howitworks`
- git: `git clone https://github.com/hariFED/howitworks ~/.claude/skills/howitworks`
- Then in Claude Code: `/howitworks explain how a four-stroke engine works` (add "3d" for a 3D cutaway)

## Atlas: machines you can zoom into
- [Light aircraft](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/light-aircraft.html) — How an aeroplane holds itself up: lift must equal weight, and the wing stalls when it cannot.
  - [Aero engine](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/aero-engine.html) — Four opposed cylinders sharing one crank: smooth, balanced power with redundant ignition.
    - [Four-stroke engine](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/four-stroke.html) — Turning heat into rotation through a four-phase cycle.
    - [External gear pump](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/gear-pump.html) — Positive displacement: a conveyor of fixed-size batches.
    - [Carburettor](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/carburettor.html) — Bernoulli's principle: one flow metering another.
  - [Nose gear](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/nose-gear.html) — An air spring with an oil damper: a strut that carries the nose, soaks up the landing and steers.
    - [Shock absorber](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/shock-absorber.html) — Smoothing a noisy input: the suspension as a low-pass filter.
  - [Main gear](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/main-gear.html) — A steel beam is the spring, and Pascal's principle is the brake: one leg bends to take the landing, one toe stops one wheel.
    - [Hydraulic disc brake](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/disc-brake.html) — Hydraulic force transmission; a master–replica pair where one piston writes and the other follows.
  - [Propeller](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/propeller.html) — A propeller is a rotating wing: each blade element meets a relative wind of forward speed and its own speed, and its lift, tipped forward, is the thrust.
  - [Fuel system](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/fuel-system.html) — Gravity is the pump: the height of the fuel above the carburettor pushes it through the lines, and a vent must let air in for every litre that leaves.
  - [Flight controls](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/flight-controls.html) — Steel cables over pulleys carry the pilot's hands and feet to the surfaces, and a small tab lets the air hold the elevator so the pull goes to zero.
    - [Elevator trim tab](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/trim-tab.html) — A small tab at the elevator's trailing edge has the longest lever about the hinge, so a few degrees of tab hold the whole elevator where the flight needs it, and a self-locking screw holds the tab.
  - [Wing flaps](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/wing-flaps.html) — A curved track turns one push into two motions: first the flap slides aft and the wing grows, then it turns down and opens a slot that keeps the air on the flap.
  - [Pitot-static system](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/pitot-static.html) — Three instruments read two pressures: total minus static is airspeed, static alone is height, and static against a deliberately leaky copy of itself is climb rate.
  - [Gyro instruments](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/gyro-instruments.html) — A fast rotor holds its direction in space, H = Iω: a torque only turns it slowly, at τ/H, so it can carry a horizon and a heading; take away its air and it drifts and topples.
  - [Electrical system](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/electrical.html) — Two sources share one bus: the alternator holds it at 28 V by switching its own field, the battery fills every gap the alternator leaves, and a breaker's heat decides when a circuit has drawn too much.
    - [Circuit breaker](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/circuit-breaker.html) — The circuit breaker pattern: closed, open, half-open.
  - [Airframe](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/airframe.html) — A strut turns a long cantilever into a short propped beam: the wing's bending moment, and the spar it needs, fall to a fifth.

## Example sheets (34, each a live 2D sheet and a 3D cutaway)
- [Floor pump](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/floor-pump.html) — Bicycle floor pump in axial section. Explains: Positive-displacement compression through two one-way valves. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/floor-pump.html)
- [Four-stroke engine](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/four-stroke.html) — 125 cc air-cooled DOHC single in section through the cylinder and valve axes. Explains: Turning heat into rotation through a four-phase cycle. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/four-stroke.html)
- [Porter governor](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/governor.html) — Porter flyball governor with bevel drive, bell crank and double-beat steam throttle valve, in axial section. Explains: Negative-feedback proportional control: the speed sets the opening, so more load is carried at a lower speed (droop). [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/governor.html)
- [Lever escapement](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/escapement.html) — Swiss lever watch escapement in plan, with a section through the balance staff and its jewel bearings. Explains: Turning stored energy into equal ticks: a clock-driven scheduler, a rate-limited event loop. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/escapement.html)
- [Bottle jack](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/bottle-jack.html) — 2-tonne hydraulic bottle jack in axial section. Explains: Force multiplication by area ratio (Pascal's principle). [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/bottle-jack.html)
- [Cistern token bucket](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/token-bucket.html) — Close-coupled WC cistern with a diaphragm float valve and a pull-knob drop valve, in section. Explains: Token bucket rate limiting (API rate limits). [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/token-bucket.html)
- [Door closer](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/debounce.html) — Overhead hydraulic door closer, rack and pinion, EN 1154 size 3, in plan section. Explains: Debounce: act only once the input has stopped for long enough. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/debounce.html)
- [Pin tumbler cylinder](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/pin-tumbler.html) — Five-pin euro-profile half cylinder (DIN 18252, 30/10) and its key in longitudinal section. Explains: Authentication by matching a secret: every factor must match (AND). [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/pin-tumbler.html)
- [Circuit breaker](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/circuit-breaker.html) — B16 miniature circuit breaker (EN 60898-1) cut on its centre plane. Explains: The circuit breaker pattern: closed, open, half-open. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/circuit-breaker.html)
- [Wax thermostat](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/thermostat.html) — Automotive wax-pellet coolant thermostat (opens at 88 °C) in section, in its housing between engine and radiator. Explains: A setpoint controller with no electronics: negative feedback through melting wax. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/thermostat.html)
- [Relief valve](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/relief-valve.html) — DN25 spring-loaded safety relief valve in axial section. Explains: A spring-set threshold with hysteresis: pop open, blow down, reseat. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/relief-valve.html)
- [Open differential](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/differential.html) — Rear-axle open bevel-gear differential in plan section, with the car in a turn. Explains: Splitting one input between two outputs that may run at different speeds: load balancing. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/differential.html)
- [Shock absorber](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/shock-absorber.html) — Monotube gas-charged automotive damper (de Carbon type) in axial section. Explains: Smoothing a noisy input: the suspension as a low-pass filter. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/shock-absorber.html)
- [Click pen](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/click-pen.html) — Retractable ballpoint pen in longitudinal section. Explains: A toggle (finite state machine) built from geometry. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/click-pen.html)
- [Centrifugal pump](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/centrifugal-pump.html) — ISO 2858 end-suction water pump 50-32-160 with its discharge globe valve, cut through the shaft and through the volute. Explains: Converting rotation into pressure, and the operating point where supply meets demand. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/centrifugal-pump.html)
- [External gear pump](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/gear-pump.html) — Group 2 external gear pump, 8 cm³/rev, cut across and along its shafts. Explains: Positive displacement: a conveyor of fixed-size batches. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/gear-pump.html)
- [Carburettor](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/carburettor.html) — Fixed-jet float-bowl carburettor, 26 mm bore, in axial section. Explains: Bernoulli's principle: one flow metering another. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/carburettor.html)
- [Pressure cooker](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/pressure-cooker.html) — 6 L stovetop pressure cooker (EN 12778) in axial section. Explains: Raising the boiling point with pressure; a safety interlock that cannot open while the resource is in use. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/pressure-cooker.html)
- [Solenoid valve](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/solenoid-valve.html) — 2/2-way normally closed pilot-operated solenoid valve, G1/2, in axial section. Explains: A small signal controlling a big flow: servo amplification through a pilot. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/solenoid-valve.html)
- [Stirling engine](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/stirling.html) — Beta-type Stirling demonstrator with a rhombic drive, in axial section. Explains: Heat flowing from hot to cold does work: the Stirling cycle. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/stirling.html)
- [Hydraulic disc brake](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/disc-brake.html) — Bicycle hydraulic disc brake: lever master cylinder and two-piston post-mount caliper in section. Explains: Hydraulic force transmission; a master–replica pair where one piston writes and the other follows. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/disc-brake.html)
- [Light aircraft](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/light-aircraft.html) — Four-seat, high-wing, single-engine light aircraft in general arrangement, forward fuselage in section. Explains: How an aeroplane holds itself up: lift must equal weight, and the wing stalls when it cannot. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/light-aircraft.html)
- [Aero engine](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/aero-engine.html) — Flat-four, air-cooled, direct-drive aircraft piston engine in plan section through all four cylinders, with a section through one cylinder's valve train. Explains: Four opposed cylinders sharing one crank: smooth, balanced power with redundant ignition. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/aero-engine.html)
- [Nose gear](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/nose-gear.html) — Steerable oleo-pneumatic nose landing gear of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft, in section on the aircraft's centre line, with its steering in plan and its wheel in front section. Explains: An air spring with an oil damper: a strut that carries the nose, soaks up the landing and steers. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/nose-gear.html)
- [Main gear](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/main-gear.html) — Fixed main landing gear of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft: a tapered spring-steel leg clamped in the fuselage's gear box, its axle, 6.00-6 wheel and single-disc hydraulic brake, in section on the leg's mid-plane, with the toe-brake master cylinder in section. Explains: A steel beam is the spring, and Pascal's principle is the brake: one leg bends to take the landing, one toe stops one wheel. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/main-gear.html)
- [Propeller](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/propeller.html) — Fixed-pitch, two-blade, forged-aluminium propeller of a four-seat light aircraft, Ø1905 mm, with its spinner and its bolting to the crankshaft flange: the blade from ahead, four blade sections and the hub in section. Explains: A propeller is a rotating wing: each blade element meets a relative wind of forward speed and its own speed, and its lift, tipped forward, is the thrust. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/propeller.html)
- [Fuel system](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/fuel-system.html) — Gravity-feed fuel system of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft with a carburetted engine: two vented wing tanks with filler caps, finger strainers, sumps and drains, the feed lines down the front door posts, the BOTH / LEFT / RIGHT / OFF selector valve, the shut-off, the strainer (gascolator) with its drain, the primer, the quantity senders and gauge, and the line to the updraft carburettor, as a schematic in the aircraft's plan and side outlines with its parts in section. Explains: Gravity is the pump: the height of the fuel above the carburettor pushes it through the lines, and a vent must let air in for every litre that leaves. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/fuel-system.html)
- [Flight controls](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/flight-controls.html) — Cable-and-pushrod primary flight controls of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft: control wheels on sliding columns, the aileron chain, cable loop, bellcranks, rods and differential horns, the elevator idler, cables and bellcrank with stops, the rudder pedals, cables and horn with nose-wheel steering bungees, and the elevator trim wheel, cables, jackscrew actuator and tab. Explains: Steel cables over pulleys carry the pilot's hands and feet to the surfaces, and a small tab lets the air hold the elevator so the pull goes to zero. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/flight-controls.html)
- [Wing flaps](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/wing-flaps.html) — Electrically driven single-slotted flaps of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft: the wing cut through the inboard flap track, the 28 V jackscrew actuator in section, the bellcranks, push-pull rods and crossed cables in plan, and the cockpit selector with its follow-up switches. Explains: A curved track turns one push into two motions: first the flap slides aft and the wing grows, then it turns down and opens a slot that keeps the air on the flap. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/wing-flaps.html)
- [Pitot-static system](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/pitot-static.html) — Pitot-static system of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft: the heated pitot head under the left wing with its ram hole, drain hole, water dam and heater; the two flush static ports on the tail cone, cross-connected; the lines, the drain traps and the alternate static valve; and the airspeed indicator, the altimeter and the vertical speed indicator, each in section and from the front with half its dial broken away to show the capsule, rocking shaft, sector, pinion and hairspring. Explains: Three instruments read two pressures: total minus static is airspeed, static alone is height, and static against a deliberately leaky copy of itself is climb rate. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/pitot-static.html)
- [Gyro instruments](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/gyro-instruments.html) — Gyroscopic flight instruments of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft and their vacuum system: the engine-driven dry pump with carbon vanes, the regulator, the central air filter and the suction gauge; the air-driven attitude indicator cut across its gyro with its pendulous erection vanes, the air-driven heading indicator in plan on its spin axis with its card and setting knob, and the electric turn coordinator cut square to its canted gimbal, with its ball. Explains: A fast rotor holds its direction in space, H = Iω: a torque only turns it slowly, at τ/H, so it can carry a horizon and a heading; take away its air and it drifts and topples. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/gyro-instruments.html)
- [Electrical system](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/electrical.html) — 28 V DC electrical system of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft: the belt-driven alternator with its claw-pole rotor, field winding, slip rings, brushes, three-phase stator and six-diode rectifier, the switching voltage regulator, the 24 V lead-acid battery, the split BAT / ALT master switch, the battery and starter contactors, the starter with its Bendix pinion at the ring gear, the main and avionics buses, the centre-zero ammeter, the low-voltage annunciator and a push-pull thermal breaker for every circuit. Explains: Two sources share one bus: the alternator holds it at 28 V by switching its own field, the battery fills every gap the alternator leaves, and a breaker's heat decides when a circuit has drawn too much. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/electrical.html)
- [Airframe](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/airframe.html) — Airframe structure of a four-seat high-wing strut-braced light aircraft: the wing's spars, ribs and skin, the strut and its fittings, the semi-monocoque fuselage's frames, longerons, stringers, firewall and door frame, and the tailplane and fin. Explains: A strut turns a long cantilever into a short propped beam: the wing's bending moment, and the spar it needs, fall to a fifth. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/airframe.html)
- [Elevator trim tab](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/sheets/trim-tab.html) — Elevator trim tab system of a four-seat high-wing light aircraft: the trim wheel, cockpit drum and position indicator in the pedestal, the trim cable loop and its pulleys, the jackscrew actuator in the port elevator (grooved cable drum on the screw, Acme screw, bronze nut, ball bearing, slotted housing, stops and bush), the push-pull rod, the tab's horn, the piano hinge and the tab. Explains: A small tab at the elevator's trailing edge has the longest lever about the hinge, so a few degrees of tab hold the whole elevator where the flight needs it, and a self-locking screw holds the tab. [3D](https://harifed.github.io/howitworks/3d/trim-tab.html)
